exposure: Stage of labor at first cesarean delivery
Cervical dilation at first cesarean delivery
outcome: Spontaneous premature birth <37 weeks of gestation in the second birth
Spontaneous premature birth <32 weeks of gestation in the second birth
Perinatal death in the second birth (excluding congenital anomalies)
cohort: 189,021 pairs of first and second births
finding: Cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor was associated with a two-fold increase in the risk of spontaneous preterm birth <32 weeks of gestation in a subsequent birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor was associated with a two-fold increase in the risk of spontaneous preterm birth <32 weeks of gestation in a subsequent birth.
